🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Musik (Music)

der Sänger = male singer
die Sängerin = female singer
die Gitarre = guitar
das Klavier = piano
die Trommel = drum
das Mikrofon = microphone

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
